citations.S1: SQL Injection in `get_user_orders`** — Query uses string formatting with unsanitized user input.
citations.S2: Resource leak in `get_user_orders`** — Connection is never closed, causing resource exhaustion
citations.S3: `order[0]` (integer ID) cannot be concatenated with strings using `+`. This will crash at runtime.
citations.S4: Division by zero in `average_order_value`** — Empty `orders` list causes crash on `total / len(orders)`
citations.S5: Float arithmetic for money in `average_order_value` and `apply_discount`** — Binary floats can't represent decimal amounts exactly
citations.S6: Missing validation in `apply_discount`** — Negative or >100% discounts aren't rejected.
citations.S10: No money formatting in `format_receipt`** — Output could be `$12.5` instead of `$12.50`.
citations.S11: No error handling in `get_user_orders`** — Database errors (missing DB, permission denied, etc.) will bubble up unhandled.
citations.S12: No rounding in `apply_discount`** — Result may have more than 2 decimal places (e.g., `$12.333...`). Monetary values must round to cents.
